description: Land Acquisition - Meethotamulla, Kolonnawa, Kolonnawa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the government's intention to acquire multiple land parcels (Lots 1-46) for the Elevated Highway Project. It contains detailed descriptions of properties, locations, claimants, and purposes of acquisition, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
